text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having carefully gone through the process 
of confronting herself, Eishin Flash had 
no more fear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having accurately gauged her formidable 
rivals' abilities and even finding joy in 
the challenge—she heads into the Osaka 
Hai.
